en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A Muslim would not be retaliated regarding the killing, nor with regards to the injuries, but (the compensation) for his crime would be taken from the Muslim for the Zimmy, in accordance with the wergild of the Zimmy, eight hundred Dirhams’.
